claims.claim: Listing all valid enum values prevents the model from inventing invalid inputs.
claims.passage: | List all enum values explicitly | Prevents the model from inventing invalid values |

claims.claim: Setting additionalProperties to false prevents hallucinated extra fields.
claims.passage: | Use `additionalProperties: false` for nested objects | Prevents hallucinated extra fields |

claims.claim: An empty description removes the semantic anchor the model uses to decide whether to call a tool.
claims.passage: The description is the semantic anchor for the call-or-not decision. With an empty `description`, that semantic anchor is gone.

claims.claim: Structured Outputs ensures the model always generates responses that adhere to the supplied JSON Schema.
claims.subject: OpenAI API
claims.passage: Structured Outputs is a feature that ensures the model will always generate responses that adhere to your supplied JSON Schema, so you don't need to worry about the model omitting a required key, or hallucinating an invalid enum value.

claims.claim: A tool schema tells the model what the tool does, what arguments it accepts, and what it returns.
claims.subject: OpenAI API
claims.passage: A tool schema is a structured description of what the tool does, what arguments it accepts, and what it returns.
